profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | Software Developer | PERN Developer
profile.summary:
I am a multilingual, English, Arabic, French, and Vietnamese, Full-Stack Java Developer with over 3 years of professional work experience. I have experience working at some of the largest gaming companies in the world as well as a few start-ups. 

Through my studies at ISART Digital's Game Design program, Per Scholas' Full Stack Java Developer bootcamp, as well as multiple personal projects, I've realized my true passion lied in the tech industry.

I specialize primarily in Full-Stack Java Development, with a focus on utilizing Java, Python, C#, HTML, CSS, SQL, JavaScript, Thymeleaf, Spring Boot, Node.js, React.js, Express.js, Selenium, Heroku, Cloudflare, and Firebase.

positions.title: Senior Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
• Built and maintained internal tooling to streamline x402 facilitator operations, performance
monitoring, and system reliability, powering a platform that now ranks #2 in total volume moved

• Led front-end development across multiple platforms, including the main website, technical
documentation portal, and facilitator dashboards supporting over 25,000 unique merchants and
facilitating more than 1.25 million payments

• Developed and published a reusable React component library (npm) enabling merchants to easily
integrate X402 payments, achieving over 1,200 downloads in its first week of release
positions.insights: Skills: Web3 · Full-Stack Development · Next.js · React.js

positions.title: Senior Blockchain Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and built an online points system used by over 3000 people in Node.js, Express.js, React.js, PostgreSQL, and Bootstrap

• Engineered and produced a governance platform using the PERN stack and Solana wallet integration to allow a community of over 5000 people to vote on different features

• Created, hosted, and managed a crypto project’s community website using Heroku and Netlify to provide holder statistics to thousands of people

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Founded and built IntRating.net using Node.js, Express.js, React.js, PostgreSQL, and Bootstrap

• Acquired over 75,000 views across all platforms, 7,790 website visits, and 1,460 unique users in the first two weeks of launching the website

• Hosted the back end and front end on Heroku and Cloudflare respectively to provide gaming statistics services to over 104 users a day
positions.insights: Skills: Cloudflare · PostgreSQL · Bootstrap · Node.js · Express.js · Heroku · React.js

positions.title: Full Stack Developer Instructor
positions.description:
• Led a 13-week bootcamp teaching 12 students full stack web development using the PERN (PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node.js) stack, covering front-end, back-end, API development, and database management

• Developed and delivered hands-on lessons focused on building real-world applications, guiding students through coding exercises, code reviews, and their final capstone project: Creating a full stack website using the PERN stack

• Provided personalized mentorship, offering code reviews and technical feedback throughout the course

positions.title: Social Media Content Specialist
positions.description:
• Maintained an organized schedule to meet Service Level Agreement deadlines for 8 large company clients that have over 700,000 followers on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube

• Monitored, listened, and responded to around 500 comments, reviews, and UGC daily in English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese using ChatMeter, ICUC Central, Sprinklr, Sprout Social, and Facebook Business Manager

• Analyzed social media sentiment performance and communicated findings to internal divisions including to the customer service and marketing managers

positions.title: Lead Game Designer
positions.description:
• Recruited and managed a team of 7 game designers, sound, and visual artist

• Led a team of 7 to create and code 15 games in C# for Unity 3D using agile
development methodology

• Designed testing methodology using JIRA and trained 5 game designers to use
the software and report bugs

positions.title: Social Media Manager
positions.description:
• Created and managed Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Reddit
accounts for YouTouch to increase the company's following by 3000%

• Edited photo and video posts using Adobe Photoshop and Sony Vegas

• Scheduled and posted 20 times weekly on all social media accounts using
Buffer, post scheduling software

positions.title: Sound Designer
positions.description:
• Composed music and created sound effects for a mobile strategy game using
Unity 3D, Ableton Live, and Audacity

• Identified team's sound development requirements by communicating with lead
game designers and the CEO

positions.title: Development Tester
positions.description:
• Tested the mobile version of Fortnite, one of the biggest games ever with over
350 million registered players

• Discovered, detailed, and reported bugs daily to the production manager using
JIRA

• Organised and communicated weekly tasks with the team in a timely manner
